_description: Configurable rate-limit thresholds for LLM providers. Loaded by scripts/utils.py check_rate_limits(). When this file is absent or a provider key is missing, the hardcoded defaults in _RATE_LIMIT_THRESHOLDS are used instead. Thresholds are (daily_warn, daily_real, minute_warn, minute_real) -- check_rate_limits disables a provider at daily_warn and sleeps at minute_warn. The 429 cooldown window (minutes) controls how long a provider is skipped after receiving real HTTP 429 responses.
